svg.aria-label: Multi-agent assistant: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Fabric
svg.title: Multi-agent assistant: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Fabric
svg.text: Multi-agent assistant: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Fabric
Copilot Studio is the employee-facing front door; a Foundry orchestrator delegates to knowledge, data and action agents; Fabric supplies governed enterprise data

g.data-tip: An employee asks a question in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot; Copilot Studio authenticates them with Entra ID

g.title: 1. An employee asks a question in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot; Copilot Studio authenticates them with Entra ID

g.data-tip: Copilot Studio hands complex requests to the Foundry orchestrator through the API Management AI gateway, passing the user's token

g.title: 2. Copilot Studio hands complex requests to the Foundry orchestrator through the API Management AI gateway, passing the user's token

g.data-tip: The orchestrator asks the model to plan and pick specialist agents; prompts and replies pass Content Safety

g.title: 4. The orchestrator asks the model to plan and pick specialist agents; prompts and replies pass Content Safety

g.data-tip: The knowledge agent retrieves grounding passages from Azure AI Search

g.title: 6. The knowledge agent retrieves grounding passages from Azure AI Search

g.data-tip: The data agent queries governed lakehouse and semantic-model data through a Fabric data agent, as the signed-in user

g.title: 6. The data agent queries governed lakehouse and semantic-model data through a Fabric data agent, as the signed-in user

g.data-tip: The action agent calls approved workflows (ticketing, approvals) in Logic Apps; high-impact actions need human approval

g.title: 6. The action agent calls approved workflows (ticketing, approvals) in Logic Apps; high-impact actions need human approval
